The StoryLa Historia

Music Runs In The FamilyLa Música Corre En La Familia

Danyera is a 29-year-old bachata producer and session guitarist, twelve years into a career that started long before it was ever a career. He comes from a line of musicians — his father founded the group Nueva Era in the early 2000s, and he grew up surrounded by Spanish and Latin music from day one.

By the time most kids are picking an instrument, he was already moving between several — guitar, keys, percussion — and never really put them down. Years in the studio alongside seasoned, talented artists sharpened both his playing and his ear for production, and it shows in every record he touches.

Today he's fully focused on the studio — writing, arranging, and producing for other artists, working with clients in person or fully remote, whichever they prefer.

Frequently AskedPreguntas Frecuentes

Can we work together remotely?¿Podemos trabajar juntos de forma remota?

Yes — a lot of his sessions are fully virtual. Send over your track, references, or idea, and he records and produces from his own studio, wherever you are.Sí — muchas de sus sesiones son totalmente virtuales. Envía tu pista, referencias o idea, y él graba y produce desde su propio estudio, estés donde estés.

What do I need for a remote session?¿Qué necesito para una sesión remota?

Just your song idea, reference tracks, or existing files (stems, a rough demo, or even just a voice memo). He'll follow up with anything else he needs.Solo tu idea de canción, pistas de referencia, o archivos existentes (stems, una maqueta, o hasta una nota de voz). Él te dirá si necesita algo más.

Does he only work in bachata?¿Solo trabaja en bachata?

Bachata is home base, but years in the studio mean he moves comfortably across Latin genres — ask about your project when you book.La bachata es su base, pero años de estudio le permiten moverse cómodamente entre géneros latinos — pregunta sobre tu proyecto al reservar.

How does the deposit work?¿Cómo funciona el depósito?
